title: MMS Didn't Say It Worked
description: Also known as Modded Monstrosity Series (DSIW). Choose your own adventure 500+ mod modpack!
body:
## This modpack is slowly growing... 
Welcome to DSIW! A modpack with over **500** mods! This modpack does not have set or created paths or quests. That is for you, the player to decide. Do you want to _conquer_ the ender dragon? Or obtain every one of the blocks in the game...(thats a lot). 
Whatever adventure you choose... get ready to face the ~~dangers~~ and the _beauty_ of the world...

There are too many mods to list right now... But here are some important ones:

- Tough as nails
- Ad Astra
- Amplified Nether
- Ender Dragon Fight Remastered
- Better End
- Farmers delight
- and so many more.

There are mods that make it harder, mods for decorating your house, and spooky mods that may hunt you... And too many to count performance mods.

This modpack is very performance heavy... You will need to allocate at least 10gb towards this pack... and a very powerful computer. Good luck.

Talk about bugs, glitches, mod suggestions, help [Here](https://discord.gg/wZBKbgGVSa) in my discord.
### Common Questions:

**When to expect the next version...** expect the next versions within 1 week of eachother.

**Will I make other versions?** Probably not... this has taken months on its own to make and test. 

**Where can I suggest mods to add?** In my discord [Here](https://discord.gg/wZBKbgGVSa)

**Where can I find the modlist?** As of right now Version 1.0.0 I have not finished the modlist yet so don't expect it until at least version 1.1.0
